To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed Cloud-integrated WOBAN (CiW) architecture provides better resource utilization, higher scalability and creates an infrastructure for service providers to facilitate different Cloud services with their access networks.

we propose CIW, which integrates a cloud with a hybrid wireless-optics access network, and that we design a cloud placement algorithm and a green routing algorithm to optimize resource utilization and reduce energy consumption in CIW.
CIW can provide a platform for service providers to provide cloud services in the access networks, and GRC is an energy-efficient routing algorithm for CIW.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design and analysis of a novel cloud-integrated WOBAN architecture that enables offloading of service traffic from the wireless mesh and the PON to the cloud components placed in the WOBAN, thus reducing the traffic in the WMN.
the design of an access network architecture that integrates the cloud with WOBANS.
the design and optimization of a novel architecture for future access networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our proposed CIW architecture provides an infrastructure for providers that can facilitate different cloud services, while improving the overall performance of the access network and providing better service to the users.
our proposed design and routing mechanism provide a novel solution to improve the performance and energy efficiency of WOBAN.
the CIW design and its GRC routing mechanism can be a good candidate for future service-oriented access networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CIW is a new architecture that integrates the cloud into access networks to provide services.
we have proposed a new access network design that provides a platform to facilitate cloud services and has the potential to improve the performance of the network.
the proposed architecture is a novel and efficient approach to provide cloud services in WOBAN, which is a promising technology for the future access networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that

cloud-integrated access networks are a promising architecture for the future of broadband access networks, as they provide a scalable infrastructure for service provisioning and a flexible platform for service providers to offer different cloud services to their end users.
by integrating the cloud in WOBAN, we can provide different cloud services from within the access networks, and improve the network performance and energy efficiency.
the cloud is not just a data center, but a new way of providing services in access networks.
